name: step188_g1_false_success_audit
mandate: MEGAPLAN Gate G1: False-Success Gap Closure (H01-H13) & Strict 4-State Status Contract Audit
safety_mandate: Absolute Hardware Lockout Policy: Zero physical PLC connections, zero flash/download, headless verification.

H01.name: Fake export success without live engine
H01.details: Verified cscape_export_project fails closed on missing/invalid containers; zero dummy CFBF generated.

H02.name: Fake open success without live engine
H02.details: Verified cscape_open_project fails closed on missing/invalid files and distinguishes offline vs live modes.

H03.name: Fake compile success without live engine
H03.details: Verified compile fails closed on missing projects, enforces download lockout (32827/33149), and uses honest AST metrics.

H04.name: Silent mocks disguised as live passes
H04.details: Verified all simulators and offline capabilities explicitly declare TESTED_MOCK [offline/DEV only] and never claim VERIFIED_LIVE.

H05.name: Global allow dialog bypass without modal inspection
H05.details: Verified modal dialog handling inspects #32770 dialogs, filters keywords, and performs targeted window dispatch.

H06.name: Straton K5 files in active code paths
H06.details: Verified legacy Straton K5 files are quarantined; zero active imports or runtime dependencies in src/.

H07.name: Hardcoded dead PIDs treated as permanent passes
H07.details: Verified ephemeral PID tests are explicitly classified as gate-dependent historical milestones, not continuous regression passes.

H08.name: Ladder constructs disguised as ST
H08.details: Verified AST and validator guards reject all ladder constructs with ERR_LADDER_FORBIDDEN; in-GUI conversion documented as BLOCKED.

H09.name: Fake 100% or FINAL_REPORT claims
H09.details: Verified AGENTS.md mandates evidence-gated progression, forbids premature victory/100% claims, and enforces watchdog discipline.

H10.name: Physical hardware port access without lockout
H10.details: Verified absolute hardware lockout for serial COM (1-256), industrial fieldbuses (CAN), USB, and JTAG adapters.

H11.name: Companion flasher utilities allowed
H11.details: Verified blocking of companion flashers, CLI download switches, and Win32 download commands (32827/33149).

H12.name: Unsupervised naked Cscape launch claiming stability
H12.details: Verified documentation explicitly records naked launch crash at 0x0051a4cd (0.6-11.4s) vs supervisor stay-open (>7,200s).

H13.name: Status contract violations
H13.details: Verified 69 active checkpoints and FastMCP normalization conform strictly to ['blocked', 'failed', 'inconclusive', 'success'].
